reviews.title: Awesome fans
reviews.comment: This was the last piece to finish this build. Absolutely love it. Fits in the Nzxt h6 flow case perfectly with no issues. Highly recommend. It's looks amazing and it's a great value for what you get, super bright, minimal noise, and keeps my 3080 5°-10° cooler
reviews.author: Alisyn Parker

reviews.title: Great fans dont hesitate
reviews.comment: Looks good and seems quiet  no rattling and easy in stall. The colors are good and the 140mm filled the gaps in my case I didn't like and these are reversed so no ugly back labeling.  For the price cant beat it plus they look very nice well see how long they last. I already had a cyberpower hub cause I didn't have all rebuilt then I started to replace and change parts so these work well with that. Also they dasiy chain this is a must if you have limited spots on mother board.
reviews.author: j lee

reviews.title: Excellent for the price!
reviews.comment: Impressive addition to my PC build! Their performance is outstanding for the price, providing excellent airflow while maintaining low noise levels. However, the RGB lighting sometimes isn’t accurate; for example, when I use the Corsair iCUE software to change the color to red, they appear almost pink. The installation process was straightforward. I appreciate the quality of the fans; they feel durable and well-made. Overall, I highly recommend these fans for anyone looking to enhance their cooling system and aesthetics!
reviews.author: Chester
